claim_being_audited: That the model should be certified for release on the current record because aggregate readiness passed and current documentation obligations can be satisfied despite a current subgroup weakness and stale prior approval.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses must be disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness passing and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support release readiness but do not, by themselves, satisfy the model-card disclosure requirement.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model card or release documentation showing the latest evaluation results, including the public benefits eligibility slice.
Provide evidence that the current subgroup weakness is explicitly disclosed as a material limitation for the named launch use case.
Provide an approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record covering the segment weakness, if disclosure is not the sole control.
Provide the approval or review artifact tying the current retrieval configuration and current eval batch to the release decision.
specific_concerns: The policy predicate for certification is unresolved because no admissible evidence confirms that current release documentation reflects the current evaluation results.
No admissible evidence confirms that the public benefits eligibility weakness is disclosed in the current model-card materials.
No approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance is shown for the material segment weakness.
The prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch, so it cannot carry the current certification burden.
The release thread contains only an informal monitoring comment, which does not satisfy the policy requirement for current evidence or reviewed mitigation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available record.
That current model-card materials explicitly disclose the current subgroup weakness.
That informal post-launch monitoring commentary is sufficient to cover the material limitation.
That prior approval can substitute for current-release documentation and current-risk treatment.
